name: F&C Fandisc in 2003 nen Natsumatsuri
original_name: えふあんどしいファンディスクｉｎ２００３年夏祭り
source:
Among other goodies there is mini AVG "Summer Return".
Main character returns to the home town and participates in the summer festival with a girl. The girl knows him, but he has no recollections of her. Is he able to remember the past and solve the mystery of the spirits festival?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
除其他附赠内容外，本作还收录了迷你冒险游戏《Summer Return》。
主人公返回故乡，与一名少女共同参加夏日祭典。少女认识他，他却完全不记得对方。他能否回想起过去，解开灵魂祭典之谜？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
